data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a modest prioryear release: an improvement of GBP 2.4m to prior year claims reserves was recognised, principally driven by favourable development in the Property portfolio. Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were GBP 69.179m. The release reduced prior year reserves by approximately 3.5% of opening gross claims. Named large losses referenced in the report (Superstorm Sandy, Mexican windstorms Manuel and Ingrid, Julius Klein heist, American Seafood) influenced prior and current year developments, but the quantified reserve movement disclosed for prior years was a GBP 2.4m improvement.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was found in the financial statements or a gross claims development triangle. The report explicitly states a GBP 2.4m improvement to claims reserves within the narrative (presented as part of 'net claims incurred'), which has been used as a last-resort proxy (NET figure used as gross was not available). No gross claims development triangle or a 'movement in prior year's provision' with a gross column was located. Prior-year movement therefore may be reported net of reinsurance in source text; confidence reduced accordingly.
